title: LEA only counts valid addresses
summary: lea eax,[rdi+rdi*4+3] takes out the lower 32 bits of the arithmetic result without reading the memory pointed to by the address.
applies: 64-bit mode for x86-64; Intel SDM Volume 1 and Volume 2
detail: This instruction can be used to implement 5×input+3 and preserve the arithmetic flag; the square brackets in the disassembly do not necessarily represent a memory access.
boundary: Not all instructions with the same square brackets are equivalent to LEA; the memory operand of MOV reads and writes memory.
relevance: When statically restoring pure digital transformation, determine whether the expression really depends on the external memory content.
